input.quote: EXCEPT WITH RESPECT TO THE PARTIES' LIABILITY FOR INDEMNIFICATION, OR LIABILITY FOR BREACH OF CONFIDENTIALITY, NEITHER PARTY SHALL BE LIABLE FOR ANY CONSEQUENTIAL, INCIDENTAL, INDIRECT, PUNITIVE, SPECIAL OR OTHER SIMILAR DAMAGES
input.rationale: Section 7 contains only a mutual exclusion of indirect/consequential damages (with indemnity and confidentiality carve-outs); there is no aggregate liability cap at all, so both parties bear unlimited direct liability. We add the playbook mutual cap (greater of 12 months' fees and USD 1,000,000) with Excluded Claims (indemnities, confidentiality/data security, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud, IP infringement) outside the cap, and confirm payment obligations are not "damages".

input.quote: Kubient agrees to indemnify, defend, and hold harmless Customer and its officers, directors, managers, members, agents, and employees from all third-party allegations, claims, actions, losses, expenses, damages, costs (including, without limitation, reasonable attorneys' fees) or liabilities ("Claims") arising out of or in connection with:
input.rationale: Kubient gives a broad defence and indemnity covering the Services, the Auction Platform, Creative, its breach of representations and warranties (which include the non-infringement warranty in Section 9(b)(i)) and its acts or omissions, with standard notice/control/cooperation procedures in Section 11. IP infringement is therefore covered and the Vendor indemnity is not one-sided, so the rule is satisfied; Customer's reciprocal indemnity is broader than our preferred position but is not itself a breach of this rule.

input.quote: Nothing herein is intended nor shall be construed as creating an exclusive arrangement between Customer and Kubient. This Agreement will not restrict Customer offering Inventory via other agents or otherwise selling Inventory to any third parties.
input.rationale: No non-compete or field-of-use restriction binds Customer anywhere in the Agreement; Section 1 expressly confirms Customer's freedom to use other agents and sell Inventory to third parties. The only restrictions on Customer (Section 6) concern misuse and reverse engineering of the Service, which are not competitive covenants.

input.quote: Nothing herein is intended nor shall be construed as creating an exclusive arrangement between Customer and Kubient.
input.rationale: The Agreement expressly disclaims exclusivity and preserves our right to monetise Inventory through other agents or directly. Section 5 makes Kubient the contracting party with Advertisers on our behalf unless an Exhibit provides otherwise, but that is a default operating mechanic rather than a sole-supplier or requirements obligation, so no redline is needed.
